Got it. I cleaned the export, normalized opportunity stages, and applied the recommended close probability buckets. Key notes from the cleanse:
- Removed 14 duplicates and merged with last activity filter (30d).
- Normalized all split deals to the primary account owner.
- Flagged 6 opportunities where ACV on record differs from recent quote; those are highlighted in column "ACV_flag."

I've attached: 1) 2026-07-31-pipeline-export.xlsx (cleaned), and 2) ACME-MAP-annotated.pdf — a draft one-pager for the ACME opportunity with my annotated asks.

Topline forecast delta after cleanse: net +$320k in committed due to stage consolidation; pipeline total unchanged. I'll produce one-pagers for the prioritized 12 accounts tonight and drop them into the Drive folder.

Next actions (short):
- Marissa: finalize one-pagers for 12 accounts (by 08/02 09:00 PT).
- Markus: review and confirm confidence bands (by 08/02 09:30 PT).
- Rishi: list any escalation asks for pricing/compliance (by 08/02 10:00 PT).

Marissa / Kimberly —

Reviewed the cleanse. Methodology notes below (brief):
- Confidence bands: applied dynamic bands (Low/Med/High) using stage * weighted-engagement-score (activities in last 21 days). This shifts two deals from Medium to Low — see column "Confidence_adj."
- Pricing assumptions: left list price intact; do not include pending discount requests unless a pricing comms thread exists. Rishi — if there's a documented discount request, we should show that as a separate line item.

I added inline comments in the spreadsheet (column: MK_notes) and the modeling tab has scenario P50/P80. No material change to net committed beyond Marissa's adjustment, but I recommend we surface the 3 largest variances in the exec slide deck.

I'll be on a flight early Monday — give me a quick thumbs-up once the one-pagers are uploaded; I'll scan and provide comments via Drive.

-Markus
